eventDetail.scope: ISAICS 2026 centers on the convergence of artificial intelligence technologies and cybersecurity practices. The conference will explore diverse topics such as: AI-powered threat detection and response systems; security challenges arising from machine learning and deep learning; privacy issues associated with AI technologies; and cybersecurity measures for protecting critical infrastructure, among others. It will feature presentations of original research and novel applications in these areas, tackling significant challenges and highlighting the latest progress in this fast-developing field.
